text: Na sigunda-fera, sientistas di Skóla di Midisina di Universidadi di Stanford anúnsia invenson di un novu faraménta di diagnótiku ki pode klasifika sélulas pa tipu: un xiipi pikinoti ki ta inprimi ki pode ser fabrikadu ku uzu di inprisoras di jatu di tinta padron pa pusivelmenti serka di un séntimu merkanu kada.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Invistigadoris ta fla ma kel-li pode leba a diteson prikosi di kankru, tuberkulozi, VIH y malária pa duentis na país di baxu rendimentu, undi ki taxa di subrivivénsia a duénsa sima kankru di mama pode ser metadi di kes di paízis más riku.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: JAS 39C Gripen kai nun pista pur volta di 9:30 óra lokal (0230 UTC) y spludi, y kaba pa fitxa aerportu pa vôu kumersial.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Kel pilotu identifikadu komu Líder di Skuadrilha Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Meius di kumunikason susial lokal ta rilata ma un karu di bonberu di aeroportu kapota enkuantu el sa ta sokoreba.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, di 28 anu, tinha badu Barsa três tenporada atrás, di Sivilha.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Desdi ki el muda pa kapital Katalon, Vidal tinha jugadu 49 jogu pa klubi.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Kel protestu kumesa pa volta di 11:00 óra lokal (UTC+1) na Whitehall, frenti entrada protejidu pa pulísia di Downing Street, rizidénsia ofisial di Priméru Ministru.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Logu dipôs di 11:00 óra, manifestantis blokia tránzitu na karuajen ki sa ta baba pa norti na Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: 11:20, pulísia pidi manifestantis pa volta pa riba di paseiu, ta afirma ma es ten ki ekilibra direitu di protesta ku aumentu di tráfiku.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Pa banda di 11:29, protestu subi pa Whitehall, pasa pa Trafalgar Square, pa Strand, através di Aldwych y subi pa Kingsway en direson a Holborn undi ki Partidu Konservador staba ta faze ses Fórun di Primavera na ôtel Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Rikordi di Nadal frenti ku frenti kontra Kanadianu é di 7--2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: El perde risentimenti kontra Raonic na abertura di Brisbane.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal akumula 88% di pontus líkidu na jogu, ganhandu 76 pontus na priméru sirvisu.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Dipôs di jogu, Rei di Barro fla: “So N sta kontenti di volta pa úlitmu ronda di iventus más inpurtanti. N sta li pa-N tenta ganha es kuza.”
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: “Papeladas di Panama” é un termu pa serka di dés milhon di dukumentu di enpreza di adivokasia di Panama Mossack Fonseca, ki kai na mon di inprensa na primavera di 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Kes dukumentus mostra ma katorzi banku djuda klientis riku sukundi milhons di dólar Merkanu di rikeza pa ivita inpostu y otus regulamentus.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Jornal Britániku The Guardian sujeri ma Deutsche Bank ta kontrolaba serka di un tersu di 1200 enprezas di faxada uzadu pa konsigi kel-li.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Tevi protestus na mundu interu, monti prusesu penal, y kes líder di guvernus di Islándia y di Pakiston pidi dimison es dôs.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Nasedu na Hong Kong, Ma el studa na Universidadi di Nova Iorki y na Fakuldadi di Direitu di Harvard y dja el tinha un rizidensia Merkanu permanenti “kartinha”.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh insinua duranti ileison ma Ma pudia fuji di país duranti un ténpu di krizi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh tanbê argumenta ma Ma fotojéniku éra más stilu di ki substansia.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Apezar des akuzasons, Ma ganha ku fasilidadi nun plataforma ki ta defende lasus stretu ku Xina kontinental.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Jugador di Dia di oji é Alex Ovechkin, di Kapital di Washington.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: El marka 2 golu y el faze 2 asisténsia na vitória di Washington pa 5-3 kontra Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Priméru pasi di noti di Ovechkin foi na golu vensedor di jogu markadu pa inisianti Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: se sigundu obijetivu di noti éra se 60º di tenpurada, ki torna-l priméru jugador a marka 60 ô más golus nun tenpurada desdi 1995--96, kantu Jaromir Jagr y Mario Lemieux atinji es marku.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten fika na 190º lugar na lista di 400 Merkanu más Riku di 2008, ku un furtuna stimadu di 2,3 mil milhon di dóla.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: El lisensia na Fakuldadi di Artis y Siénsias di Universidadi di Virjínia na 1950 y el foi un duador signifikativu pa kel instituison.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Kadia di Iraki Abu Ghraib podu lumi duranti un ribelion.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Kel kadia fika famozu dipôs ki diskubridu la abusu di prézus dipôs di forsas di Merka asumidu kontrolu.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. panha asidenti na Grand Prix di Singapura di 2008 dipôs di un parajen antisipadu pa Fernando Alonso, ki traze karu di siguransa.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Sima kes karu frenti di Alonso entra pa kunpra konbustível duranti safety car, el avansa na grupu pa toma vitória.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. dispididu dipôs di kel Grandi Prémiu di Hungria di 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Izatamenti 8:46 di sedu, un silénsiu kai sobri sidadi, ta marka mumentu izatu ki priméru jatu atinji se alvu.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Dôs fexu di lus foi manipuladu pa ponta pa séu duranti noti.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Konstruson sa ta bai manenti pa faze sinku novu aranha-séu na lokal, ku un sentru di transporti y un parki mimorial na meiu.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Kel show di PBS ten más di dôs duzia di prémius Emmy, y se durason é más kurtu di ki Sesame Street y Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Kada epizódiu di prugrama ta foka nun tema nun livru spesífiku y dipôs ta splora es tema através di monti stórias.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kada spuzison ta aprizenta tanbê un rikumendason pa livrus ki kriansas debe djobe oras ki es bai ses biblioteka.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, di WNED Buffalo (Stason sedi di prugrama Reading Rainbow) fla ma “Reading Rainbow inxina kriansas pamodi ki es ten ki lê,... kel amor pa leitura - [prugrama] enkoraja kriansas pa panha un livru y lê.”
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Alguns algen ta kridita, inkluidu John Grant, ma tantu skasez di finansiamentu komu mudansa na filozofia di prugramason tilivizivu idukativu kontribui pa fin di séri.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Kel tenpestadi situa serka di 645 milhas (1040 km) a oesti di ilhas di Kabu Verdi, é provável el dizaparese antis di amiasa kualker ária terestri, kes meteorolojista fla.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred tene nes mumentu bentu di 105 milhas pur óra (165 km/h) y el sa ta bai en direson a noroesti.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred é sikloni tropikal más forti di tudu ténpu ki dja gravadu na sul y lesti di Atlântiku des ki parse imajen di satéliti, y apénas kel terseru furakon más grandi gravadu na lesti di 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Dia 24 di sitenbru di 1759, Arthur Guinness sina un kontratu di arendamentu pa 9.000 anu pa Servejaria St James' Gate na Dublin, Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 anus más tardi, Guinness dja kria pa un nogósiu mundial ki ta rendi más di 10 mil milhon di euros (14,7 mil milhon di dóla) pa anu.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, ko-kondutor di ikipa A1GP Nova Zelándia, faze oji stória na konduzi más rápidu riba di ponti Auckland Harbour Bridge, Nova Zelándia, ku 48 anu di idadi, legalmenti.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: O Sr. Reid konsigi konduzi karu A1GP di Nova Zelándia, Black Beauty na velosidadis supirior a 160km/h seti bês riba ponti.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Pulísia di Nova Zelándia teve difikuldadi na uza ses pistola di midi velosidadi pa odja velosidadi ki Sr. Reid sa ta baba pur kauza di baxu Black Beauty, y úniku bês ki pulísia konisgi marka Sr. Reid foi kantu el branda pa 160km/hr.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Na últimus 3 mês, más di 80 ditidus largadu Stabilisimentu di Sentral di Rizervas sen es ser folmalmenti akuzadu.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Na abril di es anu, emitidu un orden di suspenson tenpuráriu pa Juiz Glynn kontra instituison, pa inpoi libertason di pesoas detidu pa más di 24 óra dipôs di ses adimison ki ka resebe audiénsia di un kumison judisial.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Kumisáriu ta fiksa fiansa, si dadu, y formaliza akuzasons aprizentadu pa ajénti ki faze ditenson. Kes akuzason é introduzidu nton na sistéma di konputador di stadu undi ki kazu é rastriadu.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Aundiénsia tanbê ta marka data di direitu di suspeitu a un julgamentu rápidu.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, tizoreru Australianu y omi más provável di susede Priméru Ministru John Howard komu líder di Partidu Liberal, dja dá se apoiu pa un indústria di inerjia nukliar na Austrália.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Sr. Costello fla ma oras ki jerason di inerjia nukliar bira ekonomikamenti viável, Austrália debe buska se uzu.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: “Si é bira kumersial, nu debe tene-l. Ô seja, ka ten ninhun objeson di prinsipiu pa inerjia nukliar”, Sinhor Costello fla.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Di acordu ku Ansa, “pulísia staba priokupadu ku alguns golpis di altu nível ki es tinha medu ma pudia dizenkadia un géra di suseson total.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Pulísia fla ma Lo Piccolo tinha vantajen pamodi el éra brasu direitu di Provenzano na Palermo y se maior spiriénsia faze-l ganha respetu di jerason más bedju di xefis, ja ki es sigi pulítika di Provenzano di mante más baxu pusível timenti es ta fortalese ses redi.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Es xefis kontroladu pa Provenzano kantu el poi fin na géra konduzidu pa Riena kontra stadu ki tra vidas di protestantis mafiozu Giovanni Falcone y Paolo Borsellino na 1992.”
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: PCA di Apple Steve Jobs rivela dispuzitivu kantu el subi na palku y el tra iPhone di bolsu di se kalsa jeans.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Duranti se diskursu di 2 óra, el fla ma “Oji Apple sa ta ben rinventa tilifoni, Oji nu sa ta ben faze stória.”
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil é maior país Katóliku Romanu na Mundu, y Igreja Katólika Rumanu ten stadu konsistentimenti kontra legalizason di kazamentu entri pesoas di mésmu seksu na país.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Kongrésu Nasional di Brazil dja dibati legalizason pa 10 anu, y es tipu di kazamentus sivil é gosi legal so na Riu Grandi di Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Projetu di lei orijinal foi elaboradu pa ex-prefeita di Son Paulu, Marta Suplicy. Lejislason propostu, dipôs di ser alteradu, sta gosi na mon di Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Manifestantis ta spera rikolhe un pitison ku 1,2 milhon di sinatura pa aprizenta pa Kongrésu Nasional na Nuvenbru.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Dipôs ki bira evidenti ma monti famílias staba ta buska ajuda jurídiku pa konbati dispejus, fazedu un reunion na dia 20 di Marsu na Sentru di Direitu Kumunitáriu di East Bay pa vítimas di golpi imobiláriu.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Kantu inkilinus kumesa partilha kuze ki kontise ku es, maioria di famílias involvidu persebe di ripenti ma Carolyn Wilson da OHA tinha robadu ses dipózitu di siguransa, y fujidu di sidadi.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Inkilinus di Lockwood Gardens ta kridita ma pode ten más 40 famílias ô más ta ser dispejadu, ja ki pulísia di OHA sta tanbê ta invistiga otus propriedadi abitasional públiku na Oakland ki pode dja panhadu na golpi imobiláriu.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Kel banda kansela spetákulu na Stádiu di Memorial di Géra di Maui, ki staba markadu pa ser frikuentadu pa 9.000 algen, y pidi diskulpa pa fans.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Enpreza ki ta jeri banda HK Management Inc., ka da ninhun mutivu inisial kantu es kansela dia 20 di Sitenbru, mas es kulpa mutivus lojístiku kel otu dia.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Famozus juristas Gregus Sakis Kechagioglou y George Nikolakopoulos foi prezu na kadia di Korydallus, na Atenas, pamodi es konsideradu kulpadu di subornu y korupson.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Komu rizultadu di kel-li, labantadu un grandi iskândalu na meiu di kumunidadi jurídiku Grégu através di ispuzison di asons ilegal ki juizis, adivogadus, solisitadoris y prokuradoris faze duranti anus antirior.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Alguns simana atrás, dipôs di informason publikadu pa jornalista Makis Triantafylopoulos na se prugrama di tilivizon popular “Zoungla” na Alpha TV, diputadu y adivogadu, Petros Mantouvalos foi abdikadu, pamodi ménbrus di se gabineti staba involvidu na atividadi ilísitu y kurupson.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Alén di kel-la, juiz supirior Evangelos Kalousis é prézu pur ter sidu konsideradu kulpadu di korupson y konportamentu dijeneradu.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts rikuza di fla katigorikamenti kuandu ke ta atxa ma vida ta kumesa, un keston inpurtanti oras ki sa konsideradu étika di abortu, el fla ma ta ser antiétiku kumenta spesifisidadis di kazus provável.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Nu entanti, el reitera, se afirmason antirior di ki Roe v. Wade éra “lei stabelesedu di téra”, y ta enfatiza inpurtánsia di disizon konsistenti di Suprému Tribunal.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: El konfirma tanbê ma el ta kridita na direitu inplisitu a privasidadi di ki disizon di Roe ta dipende.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore dja terminaba riba di klasifikason, sais pontu frenti di Noosa na sigundu lugar.
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Kes dôs ekipa ta bai inkontra na grandi meias final, undi ki Noosa ganha pa 11 pontus.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore nton dirota Caboolture na Final Preliminar.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae é un spési di família Dromaeosauridae y é primu di Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Ta kriditada ma es pasu di rapina di sangi kenti y xeiu di pena ta andaba sakedu ku dôs pé sima Velosirapitor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Se sigundu gara éra más grandi, u ki da orijen a nomi Hesperonychus ki ta signifika “gara osidental.”
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Paralén di triturason di jelu, kondisons meteorolójiku stremu ki ten vindu a difikulta sforsu di salvamentu.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman sujiri ma kondisons ka ta midjoraba ti algun dia na prósimu simana.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Kuantidadi y grosura di bloku di jélu, sima Pittman fla, é pior ki dja kontise ku kasadoris di foka na últimus 15 anu.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Notísia spadja oji na kumunidadi di Red Lake ma fazedu funeral di Jeff Weise y três di kes novi vítimas y ma otu studanti prendedu na ligason ku tiroteius di skola dia 21 di marsu.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Outoridadis ofisialmenti ka txeu kuza trandu konfirma ditenson di oji.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Nu entantu, un fonti ku kunhisimentu di invistigason fla Minneapolis Star-Tribune ma foi Louis Jourdain, fidju di 16 anu di Prizidenti di Tribunal di Red Lake Floyd Jourdain.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Ka sabedu nes mumentu ki akuzasons ki ta ser formuladu ô kuze ki leba otoridadis a akuza kel rapazinhu, mas prusidimentus juvinil dja kumesa na tribunal federal.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin tanbê fla ma otoridadis disidi kansela sigundu volta, pa pode popa Afegons di dispezas y di risku di siguransa di un otu ileison.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Naviu di 100 métrus staba na kaminhu di rikodje se karga abitual di fertilizanti y inisialmenti funsionárius tinha medu di naviu bota karga.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Alterason propostu dja pasaba pa tudu dôs kámaras na 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Un mudansa fazedu nes sekson lejislativu kantu sigundu frazi tradu priméru pa Kámara di Riprizentantis y dipôs foi aprovadu di forma similhanti pa Senadu na sigunda-fera.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Frakasu di sigundu sentensa, ki propoi proibison di union sivil di mésmu seksu, pudia pusivelmenti abi porta pa union sivil futuru.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Na sikuénsia di prusesu, HJR-3 ta bai analizadu di novu pa prósimu lejislatura ileitu na 2015 ô 2016 pa kontinua na prusesu.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Rializasons di Vautier fora di direson ta inklui un grevi di fomi na 1973 kontra kel ki el é odjaba komu sensura pulítiku.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Lei fransês foi mudadu. Se ativismu ta rimonta 15 atrás kantu el entra na Rizisténsia Fransês duranti Sigunda Géra.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: El dukumenta se kabesa na un livru di 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Na dékada di 1960, el volta pa Arjélia risén-indipendenti pa enxina direson di filmi.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Judoka japunês Hitoshi Saito, vensedor di dôs medalhas di oru Olínpiku, móre ku 54 anu di idadi.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Kauza di morti anunsiadu komu kankru di duktu bilar intra-epátiku.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: El móre na Osaka térsa-fera.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Tanbê komu antigu kanpion Olínpiku y Mundial, Saito éra prizidenti di kumité di trenu di Federason Japunês di Judo na altura di se morti.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Peloménus 100 pesoas tinha badu festa, pa selebra priméru aniversáriu di un kazal ki ses kazamentu fazedu na anu pasadu.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Un iventu formal di aniversáriu foi ajendadu pa un data dipôs, dirijentis fla.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Kel kazal tinha kazadu na Teksas a un anu y es bai pa Buffalo pa selebra ku amigus y familiaris.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Kel maridu di 30 anu, ki nasi na Buffalo, foi un di kes kuatu ki matadu na tiroteiu, más se mudjer ka foi firidu.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno é un tutor di inglês konxedu mas kontroversu ki inxina na Idukason Mudernu y King's Glory ki alega ten 9.000 alunus na auji di se karera.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Na se notas, el uza palavras ki se pais konsidera ser gross, y sigundu informasons, el ta koba na sala di aula.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Ensinu Mudernu akuzal di fiksa grandis anúnsius na otokaru sen autorizason y di konta mintira ta fla ma el éra prinsipal tutor di inglês.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Tanbê dja é akuzadu antis di infrinji direitus di otor, mas el ka prosesadu.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un ex-alunu fla ma el ta “uzaba jírias na aulas, el ta inxinaba kunhisimentu di namoru na notas, y el éra sima un amigu di alunus.”
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Duranti últimus três dékada, apezar di kontinua ofisialmenti un Stadu kumunista, Xina dizenvolve un ikunomia di merkadu.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Kes primerus riformas ikunómikus fazedu ku lideransa di Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Desdi nton, dimenson ekonómiku di Xina kria 90 bes.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pa priméru bês, anu pasadu, Xina sporta más karu ki Alemanha y ultrapasa Merka komu maior merkadu pa es indústria.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: PIB di Xina pode serba más txeu di ki Merka dentu di dôs dékada.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tenpestadi tropikal Danielle, kuartu tenpestadi di tenporada di furakon di Atlántiku di 2010, dja forma na lesti di Osianu Atlántiku.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Tenpestadi, lokalizadu serka di 3.000 milhas di Miami, Florida, ten bentu sustentadu másimu di 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Sientistas di Sentru Nasional di Furakon sa ta privê ma Danielle ta bira furakon la pa Kuarta-fera.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Komu tenpestadi sta lonji di txiga na kosta, ta kontinua ta ser difísil avalia inpaktu putensial pa Merka ô Karaiba.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nasidu na kapital Kroata, Zagreb, Bobek ganha fama kantu el ta jugaba pa Partizan Belgradu.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: El djunta ku es na 1945 y el fika ti 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Duranti se ténpu ku ikipa, el marka 403 golu na 468 djogu.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Ningén nunka ka parse tantu ô marka txeu golus pa klubi más ki Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Na 1995, el foi ileitu midjor jugador na stória di Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Kes selebrason kumesa ku un spetákulu spesial di grupu di rinomi mundial, Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Foi sigidu pa Orkestra Sinfóniku di Stadu di Istambul, un banda Janissary, y kantoris Fatih Erkoç y Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Dipôs Whirling Dervishes subi palku.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Diva Turku Sezen Aksu aprizenta ku tenor Italianu Alessandro Safina y kantor Gregu Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pa tirmina, grupu di dansa Turku Fire of Anatolia rializa spekutákulu “Troy”.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un pilotu di motosiklismu di 13 anu, móre dipôs di ter stadu involvidu nun asidenti na Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Duranti se volta di akesimentu, Lenz kai di bisikleta, y dipôs el foi atinjidu pa se kolega di korida Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: El foi imediatamenti atendidu pa pesoal médiku na sirvisu y trasportadu pa un ôspital lokal, undi ki más tardi el móre.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ka foi firidu na asidenti.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Rilativamenti a situason finanseru global, Zapatero kontinua ta fla ma “sistéma finanseru é un parti di ikunomia, un parti krusial.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Nu ten un krizi finanseru ki dura un anu, ki tevi un mumentu más gravi na últimus dôs mês, y N ta atxa ma gosi merkadus finanseru sa ta kumesa rikupera.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Simana pasadu, Naked News anúnsia ma el ta ba aumenta drastikamenti se mandatu linguístiku internasional pa riportajen di notísias, ku três novu transmison.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Tendu en konta ma dja el sa ta riporta na Inglês y Japunês, organizason global sa ta lansa prugramas na Spanhol, Italianu y Koreanu, pa tilivizon, web, y dispuzitivu móvel.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Filiimenti, nada ka kontise ku mi, mas N odja un sena makabra, enkuantu pesoas staba ta tenta kebra janelas pes sai.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Pesoas staba ta bati na vidrasa ku kadera, mas kes janelas éra kes kika ta kebra.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Un di kes vidrus kebra finalmenti, y es kumesa ta sai pa janela”, sobriviventi Franciszek Kowal fla.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Strelas ta libeta lus y kalor upamodi inerjia pruduzidu oras ki átmus di idrojéniu djuntadu (ô fundidu) pa forma ilimentus más pizadu.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Sientistas sa ta trabadja pa kria un riator ki pode pruduzi inerjia di mésmu forma.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Kel-li, nu entantu, é un prubléma txeu difísil di rizolve y ta leba txeu anus ti ki nu odja riator di fuzon útil konstrídu.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Gudja di asu ta flutua riba di agu pamodi tenson superfisial.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Tenson superfisial ta kontise pamodi mulékulas di agu na superfísi di agu ta atrai fortimenti pa kunpanhéru más di ki es ta ku mulékulas di ar pa ses riba.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Mulékulas di agu ta faze un peli invizivel na superfisi di agu ki ta pirmiti kuzas sima gudja boia riba di agu.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Kel lâmina riba di patins di jelu mudernu ten un ponta duplu ku kavidadi kônkavu entri es. Kes dôs ponta ta pirmiti un midjor dumíniu na jélu, mésmu oras ki sta inklinadu.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Pamodi bariga di lamina é lijeramenti kurvadu, óras ki lamina ta inklina pa unladu ô pa otu, kel ladu ki sta en kontakutu ku jélu tanbê ta kurva.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Kel-li ta faze patinadoris vira. Si skeiti inklina pa direita, skeitista ta vira pa direita, si skeiti vira pa iskerda, patinador ta vira pa iskerda.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pa volta pa ses nível di inerjia di antis, es ten ki tra kel inerjia a más ki es resebe di lus.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Es ta faze-l oras k-es imiti un partíkula pikinotinhu di lus ki ta txomadu “foton”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Sientistas ta txoma es prusesu di “emison stimuladu di radiason” pamodi átumus é stimuladu pa lus brilhanti, u ki ta kauza emison di un foton di lus, y lus é un tipu di radiason.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Prósimu imajen ta mostra kes átumu ta imiti fótons. É klaru ki na realidadi, fótons é mutu más pikinoti di ki kes di imajen.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fótons é inda más pikinoti di ki material ki ta konpoi átumus!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dipôs di sentenas di óra di funsionamentu, filamentu di lánpada ta kaba pa paga y lánpada ta dexa di funsiona.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Lánpada nton meste troka. Meste ten kuidadu na troka lánpada.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: En priméru lugar, interuptor pa kenderu ten ki ser disligadu ô diskonekta kabu.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Kel-li é pamodi iletrisidadi ki ta flui pa tomada undi ki parti metáliku di lánpada ta sta pode da-bu un xoki ilétriku severu si bu toka dentu di tomada ô na bazi metáliku di lánpada timenti el sta parsialmenti na tomada.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Prinsipal orgon si sistéma sirkulatóriu é kurason, ki ta bonbia sangi.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Sangi ta sai di kurason na tubus ki ta txomadu artérias y el ta volta pa kurason na tubu ki ta txomadu veias. Kes tubu más pikinoti é ta txomadu kapilaris.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Denti di un triseratops ta serba kapaz di tritura ka so folhas, mas tanbê ramus y raíz txeu rizistenti.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Alguns sientistas ta pensa ma Triceratops ta kumeba sikadáseas, ki é un tipu di planta ki éra kumun na Kretáseu.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Es plantas ta parse ku un palméra pikinoti ku un koroa di folha fiadu y pontagudu.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un Triceratops pudia ter uzadu se biku forti pa tra folha antis di kume tronku.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Otus sientista ta argumenta ma es plantas é mutu venenozu, nton é ka provável pa ninhun dinosauru kume-s, mésmu ki oji en dia pregisa y otus animal sima papagaiu (un disendenti di dinosaurus) pode kume folhas ô frutus venenozu.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Modi ki gravidadi di lo ta puxa-N? Si bu staba sakedu na superfisi di Io, bu ta pezaba ménus di ki sima bu ta peza na Téra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Un pesoa ki ta peza 200 libras (90kg) na Terra ta peza serka di 36 libras (16kg) na Io. Purtantu, gravidadi, klaru, ta puxa ménus riba bo.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Sol ka ten un krosta sima Téra ki bu pode sakedu ne-l. Sol é fetu di gazis, fogu y plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Kel gás ta bira más finu sima bu ta bai más lonji di sentru di Sol.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Kel parti sterior ki nu ta odja oras ki ku djobe pa Sol txoma fotosfera, ki signifika “bola di lus”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Serka di três mil anu más tardi, na 1610, astrónomu italianu Galileo Galilei uza un teleskópiu pa observa ma Vénus ten fazis, sima lua ten.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fazis ta kontise pamodi apénas un ladu di Vénus (ô di Lua) viradu pa Sol é iluminadu. Fazis di Vénus ta apoia tioria di Kopérniku di ki planetas ta jira a volta di Sol.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Dispôs, alguns anus más tardi, na 1639, un astrónomu Inglês di nomi Jeremiah Horrocks observa un tranzitu di Vénus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglatera dja viveba un longu períudu di pas dipôs di rikonkista di Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Entritantu, na 991 Ethelred foi konfrontadu ku un frota Viking más grandi di ki kalker otu desdi di Guthrum un sékulu antis.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Es frota foi lideradu pa Olaf Trygvasson, un Noruegês ku anbisons di rikupera se país di dumíniu Dinamarkês.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dipôs di kontratenpus militar inisial, Ethelred konsigi konkorda ku termus ku Olaf, ki volta pa Noruega pa tenta ganha se reinu ku susésu mistu.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul é úniku alfabetu inventadu propozitadamenti en uzu diáriu popular. Kel alfabetu inventadu na 1444 duranti reinadu di rei Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Rei Sejong foi kuartu rei di Dinastia Joseon y el é un di kes más konseituadu.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Inisialmenti, el da nomi a alfabetu Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ki signifika “sons kuretu pa instruson di povu”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ten txeu tiorias sobri forma modi ki sanskritu pasa ta izisti. Un des é sobri un migrason Arianu di Osidenti ki bai pa Índia ki traze ses língua ku es.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sânskritu é un língua antigu y é konparável a língua latin faladu na Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Kel livru más antigu konxedu na mundu skrebedu na sanskritu. Dipôs di konpilason di Upanishads, Sanskritu dizaparese pamodi ierarkia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sânskritu é un língua mutu konpléksu y riku, ki ten sirbidu di fonti pa txeu línguas Indianu mudernu, sima Latin é pa língua Europeu sima Fransês y Spanhol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ku fin di batalha pa Fransa, Alemanha kumesa ta pripara pa invadi ilha di Gran-Britanha.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemanha kódifika nomi di kel ataki pa “'Operason Sealion”. Maioria di kes armas y mantimentus di Izérsitu Britániku perdeba kantu es sai di Dunkirk, nton izérsitu fika meiu fraku.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Mas Marinha Rial inda staba más forti di ki Marinha Alemon (“Kriegsmarine”) y pudia ter distruidu kualker frota di invazon mandadu através di Kanal Inglês.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Nu entantu, poku nativus di Marinha Real staba baziadu pertu di provável rota di invazon, komu almirantis tinha medu di ser afundadu pa ataki aériu Alemon.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Nu kumesa ku un splikason sobri planus di Itália. Itália éra prinsipalmenti “irmonzinhu” di Alemanha y di Japôn.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: El tinha un izérsitu más fraku y un marinha más fraku, apézar di dja es akababa di konstrui kuatu naviu novu mésmu antis di inísiu di géra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Prinsipal objetivu di Itália éra país Afrikanus. Pa kaptura kes país, éra nisisáriu es tinha un ranpa di lansamentu di tropa, asi ki kes tropas ta pode navega na Mar Mediterániu y invadi Áfrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pa kel-la, es tevi ki livra di bazi y navius Britâniku na Ijiptu. Paralén di kes asons, navius di géra di Itália ka divia fazeba más nada.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Gosi pa Japon. Japon éra un país insular, sima Gran-Britanha.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Submarinus é navius konsebedu pa viaja dibaxu di agu, y fika la duranti txeu ténpu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kes submarinus utilizadu na Priméra y na Sigunda Géra Mundial. Na kel ténpu, es éra mutu lentu y tinha un alkansi di tiru mutu limitadu.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Na inísiu di géra, es ta viajaba txeu bês riba di mar, mas sima radar kumesa ta dizenvolve y ta bira más prisizu, kes submarinus éra forsadu a pasa dibaxu di agu pa ivita ser odjadu.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Submarinus Alemon éra txomadu di U-Boats. Alemons éra mutu bon na navega y na opera ses submarinus.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Devidu a ses susésu ku submarinus, dipôs di géra Alemon ka ta kunfiadu ma es ten monti des.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sin! Rei Tutankámon, asvês rifiridu komu “Rei Tut” ô “Rei Mininu”, é un di kes rei Ijípsius antigu más konxedu na ténplus mudernu.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Kuriozamenti, el é ka éra konsideradu mutu inpurtanti na ténpus antigu y el ka staba rejistadu na maioria di antigu listas di reis.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nu entantu, diskuberta di se túmulu na 1922 torna-l un selebridadi. Enkuantu ki txeu túmulus di pasadu foi robadu, es túmulu foi dexadu pratikamenti sen poi mo.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Maioria di kuzas interadu ku Tutankhamun foi ben prizervadu, inkluindu milharis di artefakutus fetu di metal presiozu y pedras rarus.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Invenson di rodas di raius torna kes karuajen Asíriu más levi, más rápidu y más ben priparadu pa pasa soldadus y otus karuajen.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Flexas di ses besta mortíferu ta kosigiba furaa armadura di soldadus inimígu. Pa volta di 1000 A.C., Asírius intruduzi priméru kavalaria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Un kavalaria é un izérsitu ki ta luta riba kavalu. Sela inda ka tinha sidu inventadu, pur isu kavalaria Asíriu luta riba di kosta disprotejidu di ses kavalu.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Nu konxe txeu pulítikus, sientistas, y artistas Grégus. Pusivelmenti algen más konxedu des kultura é Homeru, lendáriu puéta ségu, ki konpoi dôs obra-prima di literatura Gregu: poemas Ilíada y Odiseia.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sófoklis y Aristófanis inda é skritor di tiatru popular y ses pesas é konsideradu komu un di kes maior obra di literatura mundial.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Otu gregu famozu é un matimátiku, Pitágoras, konxedu sobritudu pa se famozu tioréma sobri rilasons di ladu di triângulus retu.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ten stimativas variadu di kantu algen ki ta fala Indi. É stimadu ma é entri sigundu y kuartu língua más faladu na mundu.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Númeru di falantis nativus ta varia dipendendu si kontadu ô nau dialetus txeu parisidu.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Stimativas ta varia di 340 milhon a 500 milhon di falantis, y ti 800 milhon di pesoas konsigi intende língua.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi y Urdu é similhanti na vokabuláriu, mas diferenti na skrita; na konversas diáriu, falantis di tudu dôs língua jeralmenti ta pode intende kunpanheru.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Pa volta di sékulu XV, norti di Istónia staba sobri grandi influénsia kultural Alemon.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Alguns monji Alemon kria aprosimaba Deus más pertu di povu nativu, pur isu es inventa língua literal di Stónia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: El baziadu na alfabetu Alemon y krisentadu un letra “Õ/õ.”
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ku pasar di ténpu, monti palavras ki inpristadu di Alemon konsolidadu. Kel-li foi inisiu di iluminismu.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradisionalmenti, erderu di tronu ta entraba diretamenti na izérsitu dipôs di tirmina skola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Nu entantu, Charles studa na universidadi di Trinity College, Cambridge, undi ki el studa Antropolojia y Arkeolojia, y más tardi Stória, y el konsigi un 2:2 (un grau di sigundu klasi inferior).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles foi priméru ménbru di Família Rial Britániku ki tra un lisensiatura.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkia Europeu (Trásia Oriental ô Rumelia na península Balkániku) ta inklui 3% di país.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Teritóriu di Turkia ten más di 1.600 km di konprimentu y 800 km di largura, ku un forma más ô ménus di retángulu.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Ária di Turquia, inkluindu lagus, ta okupa 783.562 kilómitrus kuadradu (300.948 milha kuadradu), sendu ki 755.688 kilómitrus kuadradu (291.773 milha kuadradu) ta fika na sudoesti Aziátiku y 23.764 kilómitrus kuadradu (9.174 milha kuadradu) na Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ária di Turkia ta faze del 37º país más grandi di mundu, y é más ô ménus tamanhu di Fransa Metropolitanu y di Reinu Unidu djuntu.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkia sta rodiadu pa mar na três ladu: Mar Ejéu pa oesti, Mar Négru pa norti y Mar Mediterániu pa sul.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxenburgu ten un longu stória, mas se indipendénsia é desdi di 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Kel ki é parti di Béjika oji ta fazeba parti di Luxenburgu na pasadu, mas el bira di Béljika dipôs di Rivoluson di Béjika na 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgu sénpri tenta mante komu un país neutru mas el foi okupadu tantu na Priméra komu na Sigunda Géra Mundial pa Alemanha.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Na 1957, Luxanburgu torna ménbru fundador di organizason ki é oji konxedu komu Union Europeia.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong é un fortaleza tudu ronbadu y un mustéru di Budista na parti di riba di distritu di Paro (na Aldeia di Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ta fladu ma na 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel kria kel fortaleza pa kumemora se vitória kontra forsas Tibetanu-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Na 1951, un inséndiu provokadu so pa fika alguns di kes relíkias di Drukgyal Dzong, sima imajen di Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dipôs di insêndiu, fortaleza foi prizervadu y prutejidu, y el kontinua ta ser un di kes atrasons más sensasional di Buton.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Duranti sékulu XVIII Kamboja stada presionadu entri dôs vizinhus puderozu, Tailándia y Vietname.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Tailandezis invadi Kamboja txeu bês na sékulu XVIII y na 1772 es distrui Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Na últimus anu di sékulu XVIII, Vietnamitas tanbê invadi Kanboja.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dizoitu pur sentu di Venezuelanus sta dizenpregadu, y maioria di kes ki sta enpregadu ta trabadja na ikunomia informal.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dôs tersu di Venezuelanus ki ta trabadja, ta trabadja na setor di sirvisu, kuazi un kuartu ta trabadja na indústria y un kintu ta trabadja na agrikultura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Un indústria inpurtanti pa Venezuelanus é pitróliu, undi ki país é un sportador líkidu, apezar di so un pur sentu ta trabadja na indústria petrolíferu.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Na inísiu di indipendénsia di nason, spisialistas di Jardin Botâniku di Singapura transforma ilha nun Sidadi Jardin trópiku.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Na 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, un íbridu di orkídia, foi skodjedu komu flor nasional di nason.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tudu anu pur volta di Otubru serka di 1,5 milhon di erbívorus ta viaja en direson a planísis di sul, travesandu riu Mara, a partir di kulinas di norti pa txuba.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Y dipôs, di volta pa norti através di oesti, más un bês ta atravesa riu Mara, dipôs di txubas pa volta di abril.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Rijion di Serengeti ten Parki Nasional di Serengeti, Ária di Konservason di Ngorongoro y Rizerva di Kasa Maswa na Tanzânia y Rizerva Nasional Maasai Mara na Kénia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Prende kria mídia interativu ta iziji abilidaids konvensional y tradisional, y tanbê feraméntas ki prendedu na aulas interativu (gion gráfiku, edison di áudiu y vídiu, konta stórias, etc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Design interativu ta iziji ki bu riavalia bu presupostus sobri produson audiovizual y prende pensa di un forma non liniar.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Konsepson interativu ta iziji pa konponentis di un prujetu koneta entri es, mas tanbê pa faze sentidu komu un entidadi siparadu.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Disvantajen di lentis zoom é ki konpleksidadi fokal y númeru di elementu di lenti nisisáriu pa alkansa un gama di distánsia fokal é más txeu di ki lentis prime.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Kel-li sa ta bira ménus prublemátiku ja ki produtoris di lenti sa ta atinji padron más altu na produson di lentis.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Kel-li dja permiti lentis zoom pa pruduzi imajens di un kualidadi ki ta konpara ku kel alkansadu pa lentis ku distánsia lokal fiksu.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Otu disvantajen di lentis zoom é ki abertura másimu (velosidadi) di lenti é jeralmenti más poku.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Kel-li ta torna lentis zoom baratu difísel di uza na anbientis di baxu luminozidadi sen flashi.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un di kes prublémas más kumun oras ki bu sa ta tenta konverte un filmi pa formatu DVD é imajen fora di ekran.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Maioria di tilivizon é fetu di un forma pa agrada públiku en jeral.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pamodi kela, tudu ki bu ta odja na tilivizon tevi bordas kortadu, di riba, dibaxu y na ladu.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Kel-li é fetu pa garanti ma imajen ta kubri tudu ekran. Kel-la ta txomadu di oversan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Infilismenti, oras ki ta fazedu se DVD, é mutu provável ki se bordas tanbê seja korkadu, y si vídiu tiver lejéndas pertu dimás di parti baxu, es ka ta ser totalmenti mostradu.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Kastelu midiaval inspira duranti monti ténpu imajinason, na ta ivoka imajens di jouzadas, banketis y kavalherismu Arturianu.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Mésmu sakedu na meiu di ruínas di mil anu, é fásil lenbra di kes son y txéru di batalhas ki dja dura ki pasa, y kuazi obi barudju di kasku na kalsada y xinti txéru di medu ta subi di masmora.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Mas será ki nos imajinason ta bazia na rialidadi? Pamodi ki foi konstruídu kastelu en priméru lugar? Modi ki es foi konsebedu y konstruídu?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Típiku di períudu, kastelu Kirby Muxloe é más pa un kaza fortifikadu di ki un verdaderu kastelu.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Se grandis janelas envidrasadu y paredis finu ka ta konsigiba rizisti un ataki diterminadu duranti txeu ténpu.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Na dékada di 1480, kantu Lord Hastings kumesa se konstruson, país éra rilativamenti pasífiku y só éra nisisáriu difeza kontra bandus pikinoti di ladrons vagabundu.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Ekilíbriu di puder éra un sistéma en ki nasons Europeu ta buskaba mante soberania nasional di tudu stadus Europeu.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konseitu éra di ki tudu nason Europeu tinha ki buskaba ivitaba ki un nason bira puderozu, y pur isu kes guvernus nasional txeu bês ta mudaba ses aliansas pa pode mante ikilíbriu.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Géra di Suseson Spanhol marka priméru géra undi ki prubléma sentral éra ikilíbriu di puder.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Kel-li marka un mudansa inpurtanti, ja ki puténsias Europeu ka ta tene mas kel pritestu di ser géra rilijiozu. Des manera, Géra di Trinta Anu ta serba últimu géra a ser klasifikadu komu géra rilijiozu.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Kel ténplu di Ártemis na Éfezu distruidu dia 21 di julhu di 356 a.C. nun atu di insendiu provokadu pa Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Di akordu ku stória, se motivason éra fama a kualker kustu. Efésius, xatiadu, anúnsia ma pa nomi di Herostratus nunka pa ka ser rijistadu.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Storiador Gregu Strabo dipôs nota kel nomi, ki é sima nu konxe oji. Kel ténplu distruidu na mésmu noti ki Alexandri Grandi nasi.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandre, komu rei, oferese paga pa rikonstruson di ténplu, mas se oferta negadu. Más tardi, dipôs di Alexandre mori, kel ténplu rikonstruidu na 323 a.C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Faze di tudu pa bu mon sta u más rilaxadu pusível timenti inda bu sa ta toka tudu notas dretu - tanbê tenta ka faze monti muvimentu stranhu ku bu dedus.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Des forma, bu ta kansa bu kabesa ménus pusível. Lenbra ma ka ten nisisidadi di bate na teklas ku txeu forsa pa más vulumi na pianu.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Na gaita, pa ten más vulumia, bu ta uza fole ku más prison ô vilosidadi.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistisismu é buska di komunhon ku, identidadi ku, konsiénsia di un rialidadi suprému, divindadi, verdadi spiritual, ô Deuz.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Krenti ta buska un spiriénsia dirétu, intuison, ô vizon ku rialidadi divinu/di divindadi ô divindadis.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Sigidoris ta buska sertu formas di vida, ô prátikas ki ta distina a kultiva es spiriénsia.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mistisismu pode distingidu di otu formas di krensas y adorason rilijiozu pa se énfazi na spiriénsia pesoal diretu di un stadu di konsénsia úniku, spesialmenti kes di karákter pasífiku, perspikaz, filis, ô mésmu istazianti.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhismu é un rilijion di sub-kontinenti Indianu. El tevi orijen na rijion di Punjab duranti sékulu XV, a partir di un divizon sektáriu dentu di tradison hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhs ta konsidera ses fé komu un rilijion siparadu di Hinduísmu, apezar di es ta rikonhese ses raíz y tradison Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs ta txoma ses rilijion di Gurmat, ki é Punjabi pa “kaminhu di guru”. Guru é un aspetu fundamental di tudu rilijion Indianu, mas na Sikhismu el asumi un inpurtánsia ki konstitui núkliu di krensas Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Kel rilijion foi fundadu na sékulu XV pa Guru Nanak (1469--1539). Dipôs surji más novi guru.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Nu entantu, na Junhu di 1956, promesas di Krushchev foi postu a prova kantu protestus na Polónia, undi ki trabadjadoris protesta kontra skases di kumida y korti di salarius, transforma nun protestu jeral kontra kumunismu.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Apezar di na fin, Krushchev manda tankis pa ristaura orden, el sedi a alguns izijénsias ekonómiku y konkorda na nomia popular Wladyslaw Gomulka komu novu priméru-ministru.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Sivilizason di Vale di Indus éra un sivilizason di Idadi di Bronzi na subikontinenti noroesti di Índia, ki ta abranje maior parti di Pakiston mudernu y alguns rijion di noroesti di Afeganiston.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Sivilizason floresi na basias di riu Indu, di undi ki be se nomi.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Enbora alguns studiozus ta spekula ma, komu sivilizason tanbê ta izistiba na basias di kel ki é gosi riu Sarasvati, el divia ser aprosimadamenti txomadu di Svilizason Indus-Sarasvati, enkuantu ki alguns ta txoma-l di Sivilizason Harappan dipôs di Harappa, priméru di se sitiu a ser skavadu na anus 20.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Natureza militarista di inpériu Romanu kontribui pa dizenvolvimentu di avansus médikus.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Médikus kumesa ta rikrutadu pa Inperador Augustus y es forma mésmu priméru Korpu Médiku Romanu pa ser uzadudipôs di batalhas.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Sirurjions tinha kunhisimentu di txeu sedativus, inkluindu morfina di stratus di simenti di papoila y skopolamina di simenti di erbanu.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Es fika konpitenti na anputason pa salva pasientis di gangrena, asi tanbê komu torniketis y granpus di arteria pa pará fluxu sanguíniu.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Au longu di monti sékulu, inpériu Romanu lidera grandis ganhus na kanpu di medisina y forma grandi parti di kes kunhisimentu ki nu konxi oji.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland origami é origami ku ristrison di ki pode fazedu so un dobra di kada bes, é ka pirmitidu faze kes dobras más konpleksu sima dobra invertedu, y tudu dobra ten se lugar sertu.
