text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: El foi dizenvolvedu pa John Smith na dékada di 1970 pa djuda dobradoris sen spiriénsia ô ku kapasidadi mutor limitadu.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Kriansas ta dizenvolve un konsiénsia di rasa y stereótipu rasial mutu joven y es stereótipus rasial li ta afeta konportamentu.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Pur izénplu, kriansas ki ta identifika ku un minoria rasial ki é alvu di stereótipu pamodi ses mau dizenpenhu na skola, ten tendénsia di ka aprizenta un bon dizenpenhu na skola óras ki es prende sobri stereótipu asosiadu a ses rasa.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace é terseru website más popular utilizadu na Merka y el ten nes mumentu 54 milhon di perfil.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Es websites dja resebe txeu atenson, spesialmenti na ramu di idukason.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Ten aspétus puzitivus nes websites, ki ta inklui, konsigi fasilmenti konfigura un pájina di klasi ki pode inklui blogis, vídius, fotus, y otus funsons.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Es pájina pode ser fasilmenti asedidu através di fornese apénas un inderesu di web, u ki ta faze-l fásil di lenbra y fásil di dijita pa studantis ki pode tene prubléma ku uza tekladu ô ku ortografia.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Pode ser personalizadu pa faze-l fásil di lê y tanbê ku txeu ô poku kor dizejadu.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Transtornu di Défisi di Atenson “é un síndromi neurolójiku ki se tríadi klásiku ta defini sintomas, inkluindu inpulsividadi, difikuldadi di konsentrason, y iperatividadi ô isesu di inerjia”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: É ka un difisiénsia di aprendizajen, é un distúrbiu di aprendizajen; “el ta afeta 3 a 5 pur sentu di tudu kriansas, talvês ti 2 milhon di kriansa Merkanu”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Kriansas ku Transtornu di Defisi di Atenson ten difikuldadi na konsentra na kuzas sima trabadju di skola, mas es pode konsentra na kuzas ki es gosta di faze sima juga ô odja ses dizenhu animadus favoritu ô skreve frazis sen pontuason.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Kes kriansas li ten tendénsia na involve na txeu prublémas, pamodi es ta “involve na konportamentus di risku, entra na géra, y dizafia outoridadis” pa stimula ses sérebru, ja ki ses sérebru ka pode ser stimuladu pa métudus normal.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Transtornu di Defisi di Atenson ta afeta rilasons ku otus kulega pamodi otus kriansa ka ta konsigi intende pamodi ki es ta aji di manera kes ta aji ô pamodi ki es ta suletra di forma si es ta faze ô pamodi ki ses nível di maturidadi é diferenti.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Komu kapasidadi di obten kunhisimentu y di prende muda di tal forma, sima mensionadu di riba, taxa di bazi di modi ki konhisimentu foi obtidu muda.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Kel abordajen pa konsigi informason foi diferenti. Preson ka staba mas na rikordason individual, mas kapasidadi di lenbra di testu torna más un foku.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Na se esensia, Rinasimentu faze mudansa signifikativu na abordajen di aprendizajen y disiminason di kunhisimentu.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Au kontráriu di otus primatas, ominídius ka ta uza ses mon mas na lokomoson ô na aguenta pezu ô na balansa entri árvoris.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Mon ku pé di xinpanzé é similhanti na tamanhu y konprimentu, ta riflekti uzu di mon pa aguenta pezu na ta anda ku pé.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Mon umanu é más kurtu di ki pé, ku falajis más stretu.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Osu fósil di un mon ku dôs a três milhon di anu revela es mudansa na spesializason di mon, di lokomoson pa manipulason.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Alguns algen ta kridita ma vive txeu sonhus lúsidu induzidu artifisialmenti txeu bês pode ser kansativu.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Prinsipal mutivu pa es finómenu é rizultadu di sonhu lúsidu ki ta spandi períudu di ténpu entri stadus REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ku ménus REMs pa noti, es stadu ki bu ta sprimenta sonu renal y korpu ta rikupera ta torna poku frikuenti u sufisienti pa torna un prubléma.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Kel-li é kansadu sima ki bu tinha ki kordaba di vinti en vinti ô di trinta en trinta minotu pa odja tilivizon.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Kel ifeitu ta dipende di frikuénsia kon ki bu sérebru ta tenta sunha di forma lúsidu kada noti.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Kuzas ka kori dretu pa Italianus na norti di Áfrika kuazi desdi kumesu. Dentu di un simana di diklarason di géra di Itália dia 10 di junhu di 1940, kes 11º Husardus Britániku dja tomaba Fort Capuzzo na Líbia.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Nun enbuskada a lesti di Bardia, Britânikus kaptura Enjenheru-Xefi di 10º Izérsitu Italianu, Jeneral Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Dia 28 di junhu, Marechal Italo Balbo, Guvernador Jeral di Líbia y supostu erderu di Mussolini, matadu pa un fogu amigu kantu el staba ta atera na Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Disportu mudernu di isgrima é pratikadu na monti nível, desdi studantis ta prende nun universidadi ti konpetison prufisional y olínpiku.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Kel disportu é pratikadu prinsipalmenti na formatu di duélu, un isgrimista ta bai duélu ku kel otu.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golfu é un jogu ki jugadoris ta utiliza takus pa serta bolas na brakus.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Ta jugadu dizoitu braku duranti un ronda normal, ku jugadoris ta kumesa normalmenti na priméru braku y ta tirmina na désimu oitavu.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Ta ganha judador ki da ménus takada, ô balansu di taku, pa konpleta perkursu.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Kel jogu ta jugadu na relva, y kel relva a volta di braku é kortadu más baxu y txomadu di verdi.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Talves tipu di turismu más kumun é kel ki maioria di pesoas ta asosia ku viajen: Turismu rikriativu.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Kel-li é oras ki pesoas ta ba un lugar ki é txeu diferenti di ses dia a dia rigular pa rilaxa y divirti.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Praias di mar, parkis temátiku y parkis di kanpismu é txeu bês lugar más frikuentadu pa turistas rikriativu.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si objetivu di vizita a un ditirminadu lugar é konxe se stória y kultura, nton es tipu di turismu é konxedu pa turismu kultural.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Turistas pode vizita diferentis pontus di riferénsia di un diterminadu país ô es pode sinplismenti opta pa konsentra so na un ária.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Kes kolonistas, kantu es odja es atividadis, tanbê es pidiba riforsus.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Tropas ki riforsa puzisons avansadu tinha 1º y 3º rijimentus di New Hampshire di 200 omi, na kumandu di Koronél John Stark y James Reed (más tardi es dôs bira jeneral).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Omis di Stark toma puzison au longu di paredi na stremidadi norti di puzison di Kolonista.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Kantu maré baxu abri un brexa au longu di riu Místiku au longu di nordesti di pinínsula, rapidamenti es stende kel muru ku un paredi di pedra a norti, y es termina bera mar nun praia pikinoti.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ô Stark poi un staka di serka di 30 pes (9,114 m) frenti di muru y ordena pa ningen ka dispara ti ki riguladoris ordena.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Planu Merkanu ta dipendia di lansamentu di atakis kordenadu a partir di três diresons diferentis.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Jeneral John Cadwalder ta lansaba un ataki di distrason kontra tropas Britániku na Bordentown, pa pode blokia kuaker riforsu.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Jeneral James Ewing ta toma 700 milísia pa travesa riu na Trenton Ferry, el ta tomaba ponti riba di riu Assunpink Creek y el ta inpidiba kualker tropa inimigu di skapa.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Forsa di asaltu prinsipal di 2.400 omis ta travesa riu novi milhas a norti di Trenton, y dipôs ta dividi en dôs grupus, un ku Greene y otu ku Sullivan, pa pode lansa un ataki antis di manxe.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ku mudansa di kuartu pa meiu kilómetru, velosidadi ta fika mutu ménus inpurtanti y rizisténsia ta bira un nisisidadi absulutu.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: É klaru ki un atleta di meiu milha di priméru klasi, un omi ki ta konsigi vense dôs minotu, debe ten un bon velosidadi, mas rizisténsia debe ser kultivadu na tudu prigu.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Alguns koridas pa kanpu duranti invernu, konbinadu ku trabalhu di jináziu pa parti superior di korpu, é midjor priparason pa un épuka di korida.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Só prátikas nutrisional adikuadu ka ta konsigi garanti rizultadus di altu nível, mas es pode afeta txeu ben-istar di jovens atletas.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mante un ikilíbriu inerjetiku saudável, pratika abitus di idratason efikaz y intende kes monti aspetu di prátika di suplimentason pode djuda atletas midjora ses dizenpenhu y omenta ses prazer ku kel disportu.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Korida di distánsia médiu é un disportu más ô ménus baratu; nu entantu, ten txeu ideia eradu sobri kes poku pesas di ekipamentus nisisáriu pa partisipa.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Produtus pode ser adikiridu konformi nisisáriu, mas maioria ta ten poku ô ninhun inpaktu rial na dizenpenhu.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Atletas pode xinti ma es ta prifiri un prudutu mésmu oras ki el ka ta oferese binifísius konkrétu.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Átumu pode ser konsideradu komu un bloku fundamental di konstruson di tudu matéria.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: É un entidadi txeu konpléksu ki ta konsisti, sigundu un mudelu sinplifikadu di Bohr, na un núkliu sentral orbitadu pa eletrons, más ô ménus sima planetas ki ta orbita a volta di Sol - djobe Figura 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Núkliu é konstituidu pa dôs partikulas - neutrons y prótons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Prótons ten un karga elétriku puzitivu enkuantu ki neutrons ka ten karga. Eletrons ten un karga elétriku negativu.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pa djobe vítima, bu debe priméru inspesiona lokal pa garanti se siguransa.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: É nisisáriu observa puzison di vítima sima bu ta aprosima di-l y kualker sinal di alerta automátiku.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si bu da pankada na tenta djuda, bu ta sirbi so pa piora kuzas.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Kel studu konklui ma dipreson, medu y sensason di katastrofismu ta intermedia rilason entri dor y inkapasidadi na pesoas ki ta sufri di dor lonbar.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: So kes ifeitu di katastrofizason, nau di dipreson y di medu, éra kondisional pa sesons regular di PA struturadu.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Kes ki sa partisipa na atividadis rigular ta meste di más apoiu en termus di perseson negativu di dor, distingindu diferensas entri dor króniku y sensason di diskonfortu di movimentu fíziku normal.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Vizon, ô kapasidadi di odja ta dipende di orgons sensorial di sistéma vizual ô di odju.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Ten txeu konstruson diferenti di odju, ki ta varia na konplesidadi dipendendu di izijénsias di organismu.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Kes konstrusons diferenti ten kapasidadis diferenti, es é sensível a konprimentu di onda diferenti y es ten graus diferenti di akuidadi, tanbê es ta iziji prusesamentu diferenti pa faze sentidu di input y númerus diferenti pa funsiona di dretu.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Un populason é koleson di organismus di un ditirminadu spési dentu di un ditirminadu ária jiográfiku.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Oras ki tudu indivídus di un populason é identiku en rilason a un trasu fenotípiku partikular, es é konxedu komu monomórfikus.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Oras ki individus mostra monti varianti di un diterminadu karakteristika, é polimórfiku.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Izérsitu di kolónia di furmiga ta marxa y ta faze ses ninhu na fázis diferenti tanbê.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Na fazi nómada, furmigas di izérsitu ta marxaba di noti y ta paraba pa akanpa duranti dia.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Kolónia inisia un fazi nómada kantu alimentus dispunível diminui. Duranti es fazi, kólonia ta faze ninhus tenpurárius ki ta mudadu tudu dia.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kada un di es tumultu ô marxa nómadu ta dura más ô ménus 17 dias.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Kuze ki é un sélula? Palavra sélula ta ben di palavra latin “cella”, ki ta signifika “kuartu pikinoti”, y el foi kunhadu pa priméru bês pa un mikroskopista ki ta observaba strutura di kortisa.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sélula é unidadi báziku di tudu ser vivu, y tudu organismu é konpostu pa un ô más sélulas.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Sélulas é ton báziku y inpurtanti pa studu di vida, di fatu, es txeu bês es txomadu di “iliméntus bazi di vida”.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Sistéma Nervozu ta mante omiostázi oras ki el manda inpulsus nervozu pa tudu korpu pa mante fluksu di sangi ta sirkula, y tanbê sen pertubasons.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Es inpulsus nervozu pode ser enviadu ton rapidamenti pa tudu korpu ki ta djuda mante korpu salvu di kualker putensial amiasa.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadus ta atinji un ária pikinoti en konparason ku otus tenpestadi violentu, mas es pode destrui tudu na ses kaminhu.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tornadus ta rinka árvoris, ta tra tábuas di prédius, y ta bota karus pa séu. Kes dôs pur sentu di kes tornadus más violentu ta dura más di três oras.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Es tenpistadi tamanhon ten bentu di ti 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Umanus ten stadu ta fabrika y utiliza lentis pa anpliason duranti milharis y milharis di anus.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Nu entantu, priméru teleskópiu di verdadi foi fetu na Europa na fin di sékulu XVI.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Es teleskópius utiliza un konbinason di dôs lentis pa faze obijetus distantis parse más pertu y más grandi.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ganánsia ku egoísmu ta sta senpri ku nos y é natureza di koperason ma, óras ki maioria sa ta benifisia, senpri ta ten más a ganha nun kurtu prazu, através di aji di manera egoísta.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Nu ta spera ma maioria di pesoas ta konprendi ma ses midjor opson a longu prazu é trabadja unidu ku otus.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Monti algen ta sunha ku dia ki umanus pode viaja pa otu strela y splora otus mundu, alguns ta pergunta kuze ki ten la y alguns ta kridita ma estratirestri ô otu vida pode vive na un otu planeta.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Mas, si kel-li algun bês rialmenti kontise, provavelmenti el ka ta ben torna kontise duranti monti ténpu. Strelas sta ton afastadu di kunpanhéru ki ten trilhons di milhas entri strelas ki é “vizinhus”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Talvês un dia bu bisnetus ta sta na topu di un mundu alieníjena ta adimira ses antepasadus?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Animal ten monti sélula. Es ta kume kuzas y es ta dijiri-s dentu d-es. Maioria di animal ta konsigi movimenta.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: So animal ki ten sérebru (enbora nen mésmu tudu animal ten; meduza, pur izénplu, ka ten sérebru).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Animal ta atxadu na tudu kantu di tera. Es ta koba txon, nada na osianus y bua na séu.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Un sélula é unidadi strutural y funsional más pikinoti di un organismu (kuzas) vivu.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sélula ben di palavra latin “cella”, ki signifika kuartu pikinoti.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si bu odja kuzas vivu na mikroskopiu, bu ta odja ma es é fetu di kuadradus pikinoti ô bolas.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, un biólogu di Inglaterra, odja kuadradus pikinoti na kortisa ku un mikroskópiu.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Es ta parseba ku kuartus. El foi priméru algen a observa sélulas mortu.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Ilimentus y konpostus pode sai di un stadu pa otu y ka muda.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Azotu komu gás inda ten mésmu propriedadis ki azotu likidu. Stadu likidu é más densu, mas mulékulas inda é kel mé.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Agu é otu izénplu. Agu konpostu é fetu di dôs átumu di idrojéniu y un átumu di oksijéniu.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Ten mésmu strutura molekular ker seja un gás, líkidu ô sólidu.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Apezar di se stadu fíziku pode muda, se stadu kímiku ta parse kel mé.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Ténpu é un kuza ki sta a nos volta, y ta afeta tudu ki nu ta faze, mas é difísil di konprende.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Ténpu ten sidu studadu pa studiozus rilijozus, filozófus y sientífikus duranti milharis di anus.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nu ta vive ténpu moda un séri di akontesimentu ki ta pasa di futuru através prizenti pa pasadu.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Ténpu é tanbê forma ki nu ta konpara durason (stenson) di iventus.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Bu pode marka pasajen di ténpu bo mésmu através di observa ripitison di un akontesimentu síkliku. Un akontesimentu síkliku é un kuza ki ta kontise ripitidamenti y regularmenti.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Konputadoris oji é utilizadu pa manipula imajens y vídius.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animasons sofistikadu pode ser fazedu na konputadoris, y es tipu di animason sa ta ser kada vez más utilizadu na tilivizon y na filmis.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Múzika é txeu bês gravadu ku uzu di konputadoris sufistikadus pa prusesa y mistura sons.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Duranti txeu ténpu, na sékulus XIX y XX, kriditadu ma primérus abitanti di Nova Zilándia éra povu Maori, ki ta kasaba avis jiganti txomadu di moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Tioria stabelese nton ideia di ki povu Maori migra di Polinézia nun Frota Grandi y toma Nova Zelándia di Moriori, y stabelese un sosiedadi di agrikultura.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Nu entantu, novu evidensias ta sujere ma Moriori éra un grupu di Maoris di kontinenti ki migra di Nova Zelándia pa ilhas Chatham, ki dizenvolve ses própi kultura diferenti y pasífiku.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Tinha tanbê otu tribu na ilhas Chatham, es éra Maoris ki migra pa lonji di Nova Zilándia.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Es ta txoma ses kabesa di Moriori, tevi alguns konflitu y na final, Moriori foi sterminadu.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Indivídus ki stevi involvidu duranti várius dékadas djuda-nu a apresia nos pontus fortis y nos paixon au mésmu ténpu ki es ta avaliaba osnestamenti difikuldadis y mésmu frakasus.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Enkuantu nu ta obi individus ta partilha ses stórias individual, familiar y organizasional, nu ta adikiri un vizon valiozu di pasadu y di alguns personalidadis ki influensia pa dretu ô mal kultura organizasional.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Enkuantu ki intende stória di un algen ka ta inplika intende kultura, peloménus el ta djuda pesoas intende undi ki es ta enkuadra dentu di stória di organizason.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Enkuantu ta avaliadu susesus y ta tomadu konsiénsia di frakasus, indivídus y tudu kes algen ki ta partisipa ta diskubri más profundamenti valoris, mison y forsas inpulsionador di organizason.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Nes kazu, lenbra di izénplus antiror di konportamentu enprezarial y susesus rizultantis djuda pesoas a sta abertu a novus mudansas y novus diresons pa igreja lokal.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Es stória di susésu diminui médu di mudansa, y el kria au mésmu ténpu inklinasons puzitivu pa mudansa na futuru.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Padrons di pensamentu konverjenti é téknikas di rizolve prublémas ki ta kongréga diferentis ideias ô árias pa atxa soluson.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Foku des mentalidadi é rapidez, lójika y presizon, tanbê identifikason di fakutus, replikason di téknikas izistentis, rikolha di informason.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Fator más inpurtanti des mentalidadi é: ten só un risposta kuretu. Bu ta pensa só na dôs risposta, nomiadamenti, sertu ô eradu.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Es tipu di pensamentu sta asosiadu ku sertus siénsias ô prosedimentus padron.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Pesoas ku es tipu di pensamentu ten rasionsíniu lójiku, es é kapaz di memoriza padrons, rezolve prublémas y trabadja na testis sientifíku.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Umanus é di lonji spésie más talentozu na lê menti di kes otu.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Kel-li ta signifika ma nos é kapaz di privê ku susésu u ki otus umanus ta persebe, pritende, akridita, konxe ô dizeja.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Entri es abilidadis, konprenson di intenson di otu pesoas é krusial. Ta permiti-nu rizolve pusível anbiguidadi di asons fíziku.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Pur izénplu, si bu odjaba algen ta kebra vidru di un karu, provavelmenti bu ta pensaba ma el sa ta tenta roba karu di un diskunhesidu.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: El teria ki julgadu di forma diferenti si el tinha perdedu xavi di karu y é ra se própi karu ki el staba ta tenta entra n-el.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: RMN ta bazia nun fenómenu fíziku txomadu di rezonansia magnétiku nukliar (RMN), ki diskubridu na dékada di 1930 pa Felix Bloch (ta trabadja na Universidadi di Stanford) y Edward Purcell (di Universidadi di Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Nes rizonânsia, kanpu magnétiku y ondas di rádiu ta faze kon ki átumus imiti sinal di rádiu pikinoti.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Na anu di 1970, Raymond Damadian, médiku y sientista invistigador, diskubri bazi pa utilizason di imajen pa rizonánsia magnétiku kumu instrumentu di diagnóstiku médiku.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Kuatu anus más tardi dadu un patenti, ki foi priméru patenti di mundu imitidu na ária di RMN.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Na1977, Dr. Damadian tirmina konstruson di priméru skaner di rizonansia maginétiku “di korpu interu”, ki el txoma di “Indomável”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kuminikason asínkroniku ta enkoraja ténpu di riflekson y riason di otu algen.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ta dá studantis kapasidadi di trabadja na ses própi ritimu y kontrola ritimu di informason instrusional.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Inda más, ten ménus ristrisons di ténpu ku pusibilidadi di orárius di trabadju fleksível. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Utilizason di Internet y di World Wide Web ta pirmiti alunus ten asesu a informason tudu óra.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Studantis tanbê pode subimete perguntas pa instrutoris a kualker ora di dia y spera rispostas razoavelmenti rápidu, en vez di spera pa prósimu reunion prizensial.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Abordajen pós-mudernu di aprendizajen ta oferese liberdadi di absulutus. Ka ten so un bon manera di prende.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Na verdadi, ka ten un úniku kuza bon pa prende. Aprendizajen ta kontise na spiriénsia entri aprendis y kunhisimentu aprizentadu.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Nos spiriénsia gosi ku tudu kel prusesu faze bo mésmu y aprizentason di informason, prugramas di tilivizon baziadu na aprendizajen ta ilustra es pontu.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Monti di nos nu ta odja prugramas di tilivizon ki ta informa-nu di un prosesu ô spiriénsia ki nunka nu ka ta partisipa ô aplika es kunhisimentu.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Nunka nu ka ta renova un karu, konstrui un fonti na nos kintal, viaja pa Peru pa izamina ruínas antigu, ô rimudela kaza di nos vizinhu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Grasas a ligasons pa kabu di fibra ótika submarinu pa Europa y satéliti di banda largu, Gronelândia sta ben konetadu, ku 93% di populason ku asésu a Internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Bu ôtel ô alojamentu (na kazu di bu fika na un kaza di ôspidi ô nun kaza privadu) ta ten provavelmenti wifi ô un PC ligadu a Internet, y tudu stabelesimentu ten un siberkafé ô algun lugar ku wifi públiku.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Sima mensionadu di riba, apézar di palavra “Eskimó” ta kontinua ta ser aseitadu na Merka, é konsiderandu pejorativu pa monti povus ke ka Merkanu di Ártiku, spesialmenti na Kanadá.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Enbora bu pode obi palavra uzadu pa nativus di Gronelândia, se uzu debe ser ivitadu pa stranjerus.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Abitantis nativus di Gronelândia ta txoma ses kabesa di Inuit na Kanadá y Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), un Gronelandês, na Gronelândia.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Krimi, y má vontadi pa ku stranjerus en jeral, é pratikamenti ka konxedu na Gronelândia. Mésmu na sidadis, ka ten “zonas violentu.”
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Klima friu é talvez úniku prigu rial ki dispriparadus ta infrenta.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si bu vizita Gronelândia duranti épukas friu (konsiderandu ma kuantu más a norti bu bai, más friu ta sta), é esensial traze ropa sufisientimenti kenti.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Kes dias bastanti longu di veron pode konduzi pa prublémas di durmi sufisienti y a prublémas di saúdi asosiadu.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Duranti veron, tanbê toma kuidadu ku moskitus Nórdikus. Enbora es ka ta transmiti ninhun duénsa, es pode ser iritanti.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Enkuantu ki ekonomia di San Francisco sta ligadu ku fatu di el ser un atrason turistiku di klasi mundial, se ekonomia é diversifikadu.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Kes maior setor di enpregu é sirvisus prufisional, guvernu, finansas, kumérsiu, y turismu.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Se frikuenti ritratu na múzika, filmis, literatura y kultura popular dja djuda faze sidadi y se markus konxedu na mundu interu.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: São Francisco dja dizenvolve un grandi infrastrutura turístiku ku txeu ôtel, ristoranti, y instalason pa konvensons di altu nível.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Son Fransisku é tanbê un di kes midjor lugar na país pa otus kulinária Aziátikus: Kurianu, Tailandês, Indianu, y Japunês.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Viaja pa Walt Disney World ta riprizenta un grandi pirigrinason pa txeu famílias Merkanu.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Kel vizita “típiku” ta involve viaja di avion pa Aéroportu Internasional di Orlando, viaja di otokaru pa un ôtel di Disney na lokal, pasa serka di un simana sen sai di propriedaddi di Disney, y dipôs volta pa kaza.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ten variasons infinitu pusível, mas kel-li ta kontinua ta ser kel ki maioria di pesoas kre fla oras ki es ta fala di “bai pa Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Monti bilheti bendedu online através di site di leilon sima eBay ô Craigslist é bilheti parsialmenti utilizadu di stasionamentu di txeu dias.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Enbora es li é un atividadi txeu kumun, Disney proibi-l: kes bilheti é intransmisível.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kualker akanpamentu baxu di borda na Grand Canyon ta iziji un lisénsa pa intirior di país.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Lisensas é limitadu pa proteje canyon, y es ta sta dispunivel na 1º dia di mês, kuatu mês antis di mês di inisiu.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Nton, un lisénsa pa intirior di país pa kualker data di inísiu na Maiu ta sta dispunível dia 1 di Janeru.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Spasu pa árias más popular, sima Parki di Kanpismu Bright Angel bera di Fazenda di Fantasma, jeralmenti xeiu di pididus resebedu na priméru data ki é abertu y rizervadu.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Tinha un númeru limitadu di lisensas rizervadu pa pididu di entrada dispunível pa orden di xegada.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Entra na Áfrika Austral di karu é un forma inkrível di odja tudu beleza di kel rijion, si tanbê komu di txiga na lugaris fora di rota turístiku normal.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Kel-li pode fazedu nun karu normal ku planiamentu kuidadu, mas un 4x4 é altamenti rikumendadu y txeu lugar só é asesível ku un 4x4 di bazi di roda altu.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Lenbra óras ki bu sa ta planeja ma, apézar di Áfrika Austral é stável, nen tudu país vizinhu é.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Rikizitus y kustus di vistus ta varia di nason pa nason y ta dipende di ki país ki bu ben.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Tudu país ten tanbê leis úniku ki ta iziji pa artigus di imerjénsia sta na karu.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls é un sidadi na parti osidental di Zimbabué, di kel otu ladu di frontera ku Livingstone, Zâmbia, y pertu di Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Sidadi ta fika imidiatamenti na ladu di kataratas, y es é maoir atrason, mas es distinu turístiku popular ta oferese aventurérus y turistas txeu opurtunidadis pa un stadia más kunpridu.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Na ténpu di txuba (Nuvenbru ti Marsu), vulumi di agu ta ser más txeu y kaxuéras ta ser más dramátiku.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ten serteza ma bu ta modja si bu travesa ponti ô anda na kel kaminhu ku kurva pertu di Kataratas.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Pa otu ladu, é prisizamenti pamodi volumi di agu é mutu altu ki se vizon di kedas real ta fika kubertu—pa tudu agu!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Túmulu di Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 pode ser kel más famozu di kes túmulu di Vale, sena di diskuberta pa Howard Carter na 1922 di kel interu rial kuazi intaktu di kel joven rei.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Entritantu, en konparason ku maioria di otus túmulus rial, túmulu di Tutankhamun kuazi ka ta bali pena vizita, pamodi é mutu más pikinoti y ku poku dikorason.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kualker algen interesadu na odja provas di danus kauzadu pa múmia duranti tentativas di tra-l di kaxon ta fika disepsionadu, ja ki so kabesa ku onbru ki ta da pa odja.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kes fabulozus riquezas di túmulu ka sta ne-l mas, mas foi ritiradu y lebadu pa Muzeu Ijípsiu na Kairu.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Vizitantis ku ténpu limitadu ta ser midjor es pasa ses ténpu na otu lugar.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km a sudoesti di Siem Reap. Es ténplu na topu di monti konstruidu na final di sékulu IX, duranti reinadu di rei Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Atumusfera sonbradu di ténplu y kel vista pa riba di lagu Tonle Sap ta faze subida di monti bali pena.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Un vizita a lokal pode ser konvinientimenti konbinadu ku un viajen di barku pa lagu.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Pasi di Angkor é nisisáriu pa entra na ténplu, pur isu ka bu skese di traze bu pasaporti óras ki bu ta bai pa Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jeruzalén é kapital y sidadi más grandi di Israel, apezar di maioria di otus país y Nason Unidas ka ta rikunhese-l komu kapital di Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kel antigu sidadi na kolinas di Judeia ten un stória fasinanti ki ta abranje milharis di anus.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kel sidadi é sagradu pa três rilijion monoteístas - Judaísmu, Kristianismu y Islamismu, y el ta sirbi komu un sentru spiritual, rilijiozu y kultural.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Pamodi kel signifikadu rilijiozu di sidadi, y en partikular di monti lugar di zona di Sidadi Bedju, Jeruzalém é un di kes prinsipal distinu turístiku na Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalén ten txeu lugaris stórikus, arkeolójikus y kultural, djuntu ku sentrus kumersial, kafés y ristoranti vibranti y xeiu di algen.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekuador ta iziji ki sidadons Kubanus resebe un karta konviti antis di entra na Ekuador através di aeroportus internasional ô pontus di entrada na frontéra.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Es karta debe ser legalizadu pa Ministériu di Nigósius Stranjeru di Ekuador, y kunpri ku sertus rikizitus.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Es rikizitus é konsebedu pa prupursiona un fluksu migratóriu organizadu entri tudu dôs país.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Sidadons Kubanus titutar di green card di Merka debe vizita un Konsuladu na Ekuador pa ten un izenson pa es rikizitu.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Bu pasaporti ten ki sta válidu pa peloménus 6 més dipôs di bu data di viajen. É nisisáriu un bilheti di ida/volta pa prova durason di bu stadia.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Paseius é más baratu pa grupus más grandi, nton si bu sta bo so ô ku só un amigu, tenta konxe otu algen y forma un grupu di kuatu a sais pa un midjor taxa pa kada algen.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Nu entantu, kel-li ka debe sta fora di bu priokupason, pamodi txeu bês turistas ta dadu volta pa pode intxi karu.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Na verdadi ta parse ma é más un forma di ingana pesoas a kridita ma es ten ki paga más.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Sakedu sima tori pa riba di ponta norti di Machu Picchu tenes monti inklinadu, ki txeu bês panu di fundu di txeu fotu di ruínas.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Ta parse un poku asustador dibaxu, y é un subida inklinadu y difísil, mas maioria di pesoas na kondisons razoável debe ser kapaz di faze-l na serka di 45 minotu.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Skadas di pedra ta podu na kuazi tudu kaminhu, y na kes parti más inklinadu, kabu di asu ta sirbi komu koremon di apoiu.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Asi sendu, spera sta sen folegu, y toma kuidadu na parti más inklinadu, spesialmenti óras ki sta modjadu, pamodi pode fika prigozu rapidamenti.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ten un kaverna pikinoti pertu di topu ki debe ser atravesadu, é bastanti baxu y ku un apertu bastanti apertadu.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Observa lugar y vida selvajen di Galápagos é fetu midjor di barku, sima Charles Darwin faze na 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Más di 60 naviu kruzeru ta navega na agu di Galápagus - ta varia na tamanhu di 8 a 100 pasajeru.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Maioria di pesoas ta rizerva ses lugar ku bastanti antisidénsia (komu barku ta sta normalmenti xeiu duranti épuka altu).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Sertifika ma ajenti ki bu uza pa faze rizerva é un spisialista di Galápagus ku un bon kohesimentu di un grandi variedadi di navius.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Kel-li ta bai garanti ma bu interesis y/ô konstranjimentus partikular ta korispondedu ku naviu más adikuadu pa es.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Antis di Spanhol txiga na sékulu XVI, norti di Chile staba sobri dumíniu di Inka, enkuantu ki indíjenus Araucanos (Mapuches) ta moraba na sentru y sul di Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche foi tanbê un di kes últimus grupu indíjena Merkanu indipendenti, ki so foi totalmenti absorvedu pa dumíniu di língua Spanhol dipôs di indipendensia na Xile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Apezar di Chile diklara indipendénsia na 1810 (na meiu di géra Napoleóniku ki dexa Spanha sen un guvernu sentral ki ta funsiona duranti alguns anus), vitória disizivu kontra Spanhol so foi alkansadu na 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Repúblika Dominikana (Spanhol: Repúblika Dominikana) é un país di Karaíbas ki ta okupa kel metadi oriental di ilha di Hispaniola ki el ta dividi ku Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Alén di praias di mar di areia branku y paizajens di montanha, kel país é lar di sidadi Europeu más antigu di Amérika, gosi parti di Santo Dumingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ilha foi abitadu pa priméru bês pa Taínus y Karaíbas. Karibenhus éra un povu di língua arawaka ki txiga pur volta di 10.000 E.D.C.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Dentu di poku anu dipôs di xegada di sploradoris Europeu, populason di Tainus dja serba riduzidu di manera signifikanti pa konkistadoris Spanhol.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Di akordu ku Fray Bartolomé di las Casas (Tratado di las Indias) entri 1492 y 1498, konkistadoris spanhol mata serka di 100.000 Taínus.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Es spasu konstruidu komu un átriu pa un konventu di séklu XVII, sendu ki Templo de San Diego é kel úniku edifisiu ki sobrivive.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: El ta funsiona gosi komu prasa sentral, y ten sénpri txeu kuzas ta kontise, dia y noti.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ten txeu ristoranti a volta di jardin, y tudu tardi y noti ta fazedu konsertus di grasa di gazebo sentral.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Beku di Beju). Dôs varandas siparadu pa apénas 69 sentímetru é lar di lenda di amor antigu.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pa alguns séntimus alguns kriansas ta konta-bu kel stória.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Ilha di Bowen é un viajen di un dia ô paseiu di fin di simana pupular ki ta ten kaiaki, kaminhadas, lojas, ristoranti, y mutu más.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Es auténtiku kumunidadi sta lokalizadu na Howe Sound, pertu di Vancouver, y ta tixiga la faxi na kes taksi akuátikus ki ta sai di ilha di Granville, na sentru di Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pa kes ki gosta di atividadis au ar livri, un kaminhada pa kuredor di Mar a Séu é esensial.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 óra di karu di Vancouver) é karu mas é konxedu dretu pamodi kel Jogus Olínpiku di Invernu di 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Na invernu, disfruta di alguns di kes midjor ski di Amérika du norti, y na veron sprimenta un oténtiku siklismu di montanha.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Lisensas debe ser rizervadu ku antisidénsia. Bu debe ten un outorizason pa pasa noti na Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena é úniku postu di guarda-florestal ki ta oferese alojamentu na durmitóriu y rifeisons kenti, alén di akanpamentu. La Leona, San Pedrillo, y Los Patos ta oferese apénas kanpismu sen sirvisu di alimentason.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: É pusível konsigi lisensas di stasionamentu diretamenti di Stason Ranger na Puerto Jiménez, mas es ka ta aseita karton di kréditu.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Sirvisu di Parki (MINAE) ka ta imiti lisensas di parki ku más di un mês di antesidênsia di dia xigada antisipadu.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ta oferese un sirvisu di rizerva pa un taxa di 30 dóla, ô 10 dóla pa pasi di un dia; más informason na ses pájina di Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Ilhas Cook é un país insular ku livri asosiason ku Nova Zelándia, lokalizadu na Polinézia, na meiu di Osianu Pasífiku di sul.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: É un arkipelagu ku 15 ilha spadjadu pa más di 2.2 milhon di km2 di osianu.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ku mésmu fuzu oráriu di Havai, kes ilhas é asvês konsideradu komu “Hawaii la dibaxu”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Enbora más pikinoti, el ta lenbra alguns vizitantis más grandi di Havai antis statutu di stadu, sen kes grandi ôtel turístiku y otus enpriendimentu.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Ilhas Cook ka ten ninhun sidadi, mas el ten 15 ilhas diferenti. Kes prinsipal é Rarotonga y Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Oji en dia, na país dizenvolvidu, oferta di kamas y kafé di luxu dja ilevadu a un spési di forma di arti.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: La di riba, B&Bs ta konpiti obviamenti prinsipalmenti na dôs grandi kuza: ropa di kama y kafé.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Nes sentidu, na midjor des stabelesimentu bu pode atxa ropa di kama más luxuozu, talvês un kolxa fetu a mon ô un kama antigu.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Kafé pode inklui dilísias sazonal di rijion ô pratu spesial di anfitrion.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kel ambienti poder ser un edifísiu stóriku antigu ku mobilias antigu, terenu manikuri y un pisina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Entra na bu karu di bo y sai na strada na un viaji kunpridu ten un atrason intrínsiku na se sinplisidadi.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Au kontráriu di veíkulus más grandi, provavelmenti dja bu sta familiarizadu ku konduzi bu karu y bu konxe se limitasons.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Monta un tenda na un propriedadi privadu ô na un sidadi di kualker tamanhu pode fasilmenti atrai atenson indizejadu.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Enfin, utiliza bu karu é un ótimu manera di faze un viajen di karu, mas raramenti en si é un manera di “akanpa”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kapamentu na karu é pusível si bu tiver un karinha kumesial grandi, Djipi, Sedan ô Station Wagon ku kadéras ki ta déta.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Alguns ôtel ten un patrimóniu di éra doradu di kaminhus-di -feru di konboiu a vapor y di navius tranzantlântikus; antis di Sigundu Géra Mundial, na sékulu XIX ô na inísiu di sékulu XX.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Es ôtel éra undi ki kes rikus y famozus di dia ta fikaba ôspedadu, y txeu bês es ta tinha rifeisons y vida noturnu sofistikadu.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Kes asesóriu antikuadu, kel falta di komodidadi más risenti, y un sertu envelhesimentu grasiozu tanbê ta faze parti di ses karákter.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Apézar di es é normalmenti propriedadi privadu, asvês es ta resebe xefis di stadu vizitantis y otus personalidadi.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viajanti ku monton di dinheru pode konsidera un viajen a volta di mundu, xeiu di stadia na monti di kes ôtel li.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Un redi di interkânbiu ôteleru é organizason ki ta konekta viajantis ku abitantis lokal di sidadis ki es sa ta ba vizita.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Adizon a es redi ta iziji normalmenti so prenximentu di un formuláriu online; enbora alguns redi ta oferese ô iziji otus verifikason.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Un lista di ôspidis dispunível é fornesedu ô na verson inprimidu y/ô online, asvês ku riferénsias y kumentárius di otus viajantis.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing foi fundadu na Janeru di 2004 dipôs ki prugramador informátiku Casey Fenton atxa un bilheti di avion baratu pa Islândia, mas el ka tinha un lugar di fika.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: El manda un email pa studantis di universitadi lokal y el resebe un númeru inkrivel di ofertas di alojamentu di grasa.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Pouzadas ta presta sirvisus prinsipalmenti pa jovens - un ôspidi típiku ten uns vinti y poku anus - mas tanbê la bu pode atxa txeu bês viajantis más bedju.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Famílias ku kriansas é un imajen raru, mas alguns pozada ta dexa-s fika na kuartus privadu.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Sidadi di Pekin na Xina ta bai ser palku di Jogus Olínpiku na Invernu di 2022, y ta torna-l priméru sidadi a ser resebe Jogus Olínpiku di veron y di invernu.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pikin ta ser palku si serimónias di abertura y inseramentu y di iventus na jélu di salon.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Otus iventus di ski ta ba ser na ária di ski di Taizicheng, na Zhangjiakou, serka di 220 km (140 milhas) di Pekin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Maioria di ténplus ten un festival anual ki ta kumesa na final di Nuvenbru ti miadus di Maiu, ki ta varia di akordu ku kalendáriu anual di kada ténplu.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Maioria di kes festival di ténplu é selebradu pa aniversáriu di ténplu ô di aniversáriu di divindadi ô kualker otu iventu inpurtanti asosiadu a ténplu.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Festival di ténplu di Kerala é mutu interesanti di odja, ku prosison regular di elefantis dikoradu, orkestra di ténplu y otus festividadis.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Un Fera Mundial (vulgarmenti txomadu di Spozison Mundial, ô sinplismenti Expo) é un grandi festival internasional di artis y siénsias.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Paízis partisipanti ta aprizenta spuzisons artístiku y idukasional na pavilhon nasional pa mostra kesprublémas mundial ô kultura y stória di ses país.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Spozison Internasional di Ortikultura é iventus spesializadu ki ta mostra spozisons floral, jardins botániku y tudu kel ki ten a ver ku plantas.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Apézar di na tioria es pode kontise tudu anu (desdi ki é na país diferenti), na prátika ka é.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Es iventus ta dura normalmenti entri três a sais mês, y es ta rializadu na lokal ku un ária ka inferior a 50 ekitar.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ten txeu formatus diferenti di filmi ki dja uzadu duranti anus. Pilílkula padron di 35 mm (negativu di 36 pur 24 mm) é kel más ki ten.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Normalmenti el pode riabastesidu ku txeu fasilidadi si bu seka, y da un rizoluson más ô ménus konparável a un DSLR di gosi.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Alguns kámaras di filme di formatu médiu ta uza un formatu di 6 pa 6 cm, más konkretamenti un negativu di 56 pa 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Kel-li ta da un rizoluson kuazi kuatu bês superior a di un negativu di 35 mm (3136 mm2 kontra 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Vida selvajen sta entri motivus más dizafiador pa un fotógrafu y ta meste di un konbinason di bon sorti, pasiénsia, spiriénsia y bon ekipamentu.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografia di vida selvajen é txeu bês tomadu komu sertu, mas sima fotografia en jeral, un imajen bali más di ki mil palavra.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografia di vida selvajen txeu bês ta meste di un lenti teleobjetivu kunpridu, apézar di kuzas sima un bandu di pásus ô un kriatura minúskulu ta meste di otus lentis.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Monti animal ezótikus é difisel di atxa, y parkis ten asvês regras di modi ke pa tra fotu pa fin kumersial.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Animal selvajen es pode ser tímidu ô agresivu. Anbienti pode sta friu, kenti, ô di otu forma ostil.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Mundu ten más di 5.000 língua diferenti, inkluindu más di vinti ku 50 milhon ô más di falantis.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Palavras skritu é txeu bês más fásil di konprende di ki palavras faladu, tanbê. Kel-li é spesialmenti verdadi na kazu di inderesus, ki txeu bês é difísil di prununsia di forma intelijível.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Munti nasons interu é konpletamenti fluenti na Inglês, y na mutu más bu pode spera un kunhisimentu limitadu - spesialmenti entri más jovens.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imajina, si bu kre, un Mankunianu, Bostonianu, Jamaikanu y Sydneysider xintadu a volta di un meza ta janta nun ristoranti na Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Es sa ta lenbra kunpanheru di stória di ses sidadi natal, ki ta kontada na ses sutaki diferenti y kalon lokal.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kunpra kumida na supermerkadu é jeralmenti forma más baratu di alimenta. Sen oportunidadis di kuzinha, skolhas é, nu entantu, limitadu a alimentus prontu.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Kada bês más supermerkadus sa ta poi un sekson más variadu di kumida prontu pa kume. Alguns ti ta da un fornu di mikronda ô otus meius pa kenta kumida.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Na alguns país ô tipus di lojas izisti peloménus un ristoranti na lokal, txeu bês un ristoranti bastanti informal ku presus asesível.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Faze y leba ku bo kópias di bu apólisi y dadus di kontaktu di bu siguradora.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Es ten ki mostra email di siguradora y númerus di tilifoni internasional pa akonselhamentu/otorizasons y aprizentason di riklamason.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Ten otu kópia na bu bagajen y online (manda email pa bu kabesa ku aneksu, ô ten el guardadu na “cloud”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si bu viaja ku un portátil ô tablet, guarda un kópia na bu mimória ô disku (asesível sen Internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
